summary: Loads texture resources from a stream. Reads an entry count via ArithmeticComparison_a5c0 and loops over entries, allocating and initializing a 196-byte resource object per entry (ConstructorInputControlInit), configuring flags, dimensions (sub_547240), and a simple field (SimpleSetter_71c0). For each entry with sub-resources, allocates a 148-byte-stride array initialized by StructInitWithDefaults_fb90 and stored at resource field [42]. Optionally generates a random name suffix, deduplicates by name via ArithmeticComparisonBinarySearch (freeing duplicates) or appends via sub_547670. Then iterates sub-resources: reads render-state tokens, dispatches on element field [24] values to conditional setters (sub_546F30 / sub_546FE0 / sub_546F70 / GuardedRenderStateSet / ConditionalRenderStateSetup), and propagates element flags into resource flags. Returns 0 when all entries are processed, -1 on render-state setter failure.

operations.description: Read a texture entry count token from the stream via ArithmeticComparison_a5c0(4).
If the entry count v27 is <= 0, return 0 immediately (no entries to load).
Outer loop over texture entries; one 196-byte resource object is allocated and initialized per iteration.
Allocate a 196-byte resource object via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper and initialize it via ConstructorInputControlInit; store the parent pointer this at resource field [46].
Read texture header tokens from the stream via ArithmeticComparison_a5c0 with sizes 32, 4, 16, 16, 16, 16, 4, 4.
Set flag bit 2 on the resource flags field [39].
Configure resource dimensions via sub_547240 with WORD values v22 and v23, and a simple field via SimpleSetter_71c0 with v28.
If sub-resource count field [41] is > 0, allocate an array of 148*count+4 bytes, store the count as a header word, and initialize each 37-dword sub-resource element via StructInitWithDefaults_fb90.
Store the allocated sub-resource array pointer at resource field [42].

If flag 0x200 is set on resource field [39], generate a random name suffix via RandomPasswordKeyGenerator into a scratch buffer, store it into the resource name area via sub_587DD0, and append it to the resource name with strcat.

Search for an existing texture with the same name via ArithmeticComparisonBinarySearch; if found, release the duplicate via ArrayCleanupWithDualFree, EmptyStub_7470 and FreeWrapper_7bcf; otherwise append the resource via sub_547670 and set flag bit 1 on field [39].
Inner loop over the sub-resource elements; reads per-sub-resource settings from the stream and applies them.
Read sub-resource tokens via ArithmeticComparison_a5c0(32); if element field [18] is > 1, allocate a 4*field[20] byte buffer via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper and store it at element field [19].

Read per-sub-resource render-state tokens; apply FloatToIntMultiply, FieldSetterAt0x80 with (v24 & 0xFFFFFF), sub_54FCC0 with HIBYTE(v24), and PlaybackRateConfigSetter with ((*v12 & 0xC), element field [17]).
Dispatch on element field [24] value: match unk_800000 -> sub_546F70; 0x100000 -> sub_546F30; 0x400000 -> sub_546FE0; 0x1000000 -> ConditionalRenderStateSetup; 0x8000000 -> GuardedRenderStateSet.
Clear bits 0x100 and 0x200 on the first word of the element; propagate element flags into the resource flags: bit 0x100 sets flag 0x200 on field [39], bit 0x200 sets flag 0x4000 on field [39].
Advance to the next sub-resource element (37 dwords) and increment the element counter; repeat until the counter reaches the sub-resource count field [41], then return to the outer entry loop.
Return -1 when a required render-state setter fails, and 0 when all texture entries have been processed.

if (r->[39] & 0x200) { random_suffix(a2, buf); store_suffix(r->name, buf); strcat(r->name, buf); }
